description: Discover replayable workflows in an agent's session history (defaults to ~/.claude/projects). Returns each session's transcript path — feed one to reelier_from_session. Only MCP/HTTP tool-call sequences are replayable; native file/shell actions are reported as skipped, never fabricated into a fake result. USE WHEN: deciding which past work is worth compiling into a replayable skill.

dir.description: Directory to scan for agent session transcripts (default: ~/.claude/projects).

name: reelier_scan
